purpose: Close the existing ordinary single-scene transition obligations with recognized native input and exact baseline/candidate ownership. No production SDK change.

build_contract.physical_build_admission: Only after live device/signing readiness; simulator preparation independent.

environments.duo: Existing qualified Duo27.1 simulator, real Closed/Open displays; no boot recovery or automated gesture path.
environments.physical_ipad: One connected, unlocked, resize-capable iPadOS18+ with actual native input and signed task products. Rediscover before admission. Relevant physical iPad coverage, never physical Duo certification.

reuse.scope: When its selected-source automatic UIKit/SwiftUI split cells pass, reuse actual Detail-before-close and Detail-after-reopen geometry/selection/mapper evidence for Duo H14. Initial Open supplies Root evidence only. No duplicate automatic Duo split cells or backend claim.

stack_scenario: Home readiness; tap Open detail and wait for exact native/mapper readiness
Complete one real interactive edge pop; wait for terminal callback and fresh Home owner
Open Detail again; cancel one real interactive edge pop; preserve outgoing owner
Present native sheet; complete one real interactive dismissal; wait for callback work and returned Detail owner
Re-present sheet; cancel one real interactive dismissal; preserve Sheet owner
Dismiss remaining sheet using its ordinary button; return Home through ordinary navigation; one genuine Home background drain
split_scenario: Select Detail through ordinary split navigation and capture its real selection/path
Duo: Open, Closed, Open while retaining selected Detail; physical iPad: regular, compact, regular through real window resize

Before each dependent navigation step capture actual display, geometry, complete controller inventory and exact selected path; join the complete resulting view inventory without adding synthetic marker work.
Return to original pose/window configuration, then one genuine Home background drain
observation_design: Passive public controller graph; no inserted host/controller, swizzle, input delivery or replacement of framework-owned delegates.

At an interactive-only durable readiness snapshot, add one observation target to each existing public pan recognizer in the owned window. At the first actual .began callback require one initiallyInteractive/isInteractive coordinator and attach real interaction-change/completion callbacks. Missing or late registration is INVALID. No periodic scan supplies a gesture or coordinator.
Retain exact coordinator/from/to/window/controller identities, native monotonic ordering, recognized interaction changes/cancellation, actual native stack and declared SwiftUI path/selection.

Callback work is a separately labelled custom action from the actual transition completion callback; it never substitutes for automatic action coverage. Capture contemporaneous mapper context under the evidence lock before dispatch.

Snapshot requests, ordered off-main persistence, actual screenshot/display responses, publication, human supervisor, process quiescence and task-only cleanup reuse existing acceptance components. Frozen prior helper bytes remain unchanged.

Snapshot original recognizer policies, delegate, view/window and enablement; own no existing delegate. Remove only own targets on completion, new readiness, failure and background. Preserve terminal attachment/enablement separately because native pop/dismissal legitimately changes them. Reject late callbacks.
decisive_assertions: One source-bound ordinary scene and fixture-owned key window; retain complete auxiliary window inventory with public source provenance. No cardinality or private-class whitelist.
Before-input readiness is durable, current and unconsumed. Native callback chains begin after that boundary and terminal effects precede subsequent input.

Cancellation preserves the outgoing owner; completed navigation/dismissal gives the correctly observed return occurrence and real callback work. Automatic baseline limitations require explicit paired source classification and cannot be represented as repaired.
SwiftUI automatic uses public default predicates; manual uses only existing trackRUMView modifiers with automatic view tracking disabled. No semantic S3 targets or raw start/stop substitute.
Adaptive steps prove actual changed display/native geometry and stable selected path. Capture owners independently; same name is not same occurrence.

Join complete local mapper inventory with exact application/session backend inventory, terminal versions/counters, non-view identities and callback owners. Reject missing/extra/duplicate/stale events; isolate incidental ApplicationLaunch/TTID explicitly.
Keep scenario, evidence and cleanup verdicts separate; required missing evidence/cleanup makes overall acceptance INVALID. SDK attribution requires a valid native scenario and selected source proof.
budget_basis: Build900s follows existing two-target automatic builds; each finite stack has four human interactive boundaries plus setup/return taps within1800s. Human180s, capture30s, backend600s and cleanup300s reuse measured recent S2 budgets. No original deadline is changed.

attempt_policy.qualification: First planned UIKit baseline cell qualifies the passive transition witness. On mechanism failure stop that path; preserve evidence and all unrun cells. No SDK-on/off diagnostic series.

offline_controls: Missing or reordered native path/selection proof
Extra/missing backend event and incomplete pagination
next_action: Review and remove repeated immutable metadata work while retaining actual live topology and unchanged cost threshold; define any build/native continuation before implementation.
physical_mapping: The S2 rows require a relevant physical iPhone/iPad, not both. This finite matrix explicitly selects one resize-capable physical iPad for H11/H12/H13 as well as H14. It makes no physical iPhone or Duo claim; all automatic/manual/source pairs are retained.
review_adjustments: Independent native/mapper evidence; no assumed SDK interactive coordinator.
First-began registration and recognizer target lifecycle; no polling rescue.
Explicit12cell physicaliPad mapping and deferred SwiftUI callbacks.
Native attachment/enablement changes are captured as observations, never falsely attributed to an observer assignment.

Reviewer withdrew a requested animations_queued=true assertion after verifying the actual UIKit header: completion-only registration may return false while its genuine completion still runs. Keep the Boolean diagnostic and strict actual callback ordering.

Runtime review required exact original display/window/selection restoration and an immutable aggregate stage clock. Both are enforced and covered by negative controls; preparation approval adds no runtime or gate credit.

remaining: Fresh operator/environment admission and actual eight-cell Duo comparison
Live physical iPad/signing availability, two physical build keys and twelve required cells
Final backend/source classifications and release gate review

review.scope: Fixture/native and local paired oracle only. Full runtime, backend, adaptive geometry and physical execution remain unqualified.

live_environment.qualification_limit: Physical baseline preparation and native run executed; transport/observer failure stops current path. No release qualification.

No existing or active clock changes. Duo aggregate stage is21600seconds (eight2700second native/backend/cleanup reservations), with300seconds final cleanup. Each cell must fit its complete original reservation; later readiness never renews the stage.

decisive_controls: Actual returned display and exact original restoration
Foremost native controller, real selection and mapper occurrences
Consumed readiness and process start/PID/executable substitution
Missing/extra/foreign backend events and exact reducer counts
Original uploader stays alive until complete persisted evidence; final stream equals frozen inventory
Late publication, worker absence and incomplete cleanup cannot qualify the next cell

physical_preparation.device: wired iPad Pro11 third generation, iPadOS27.0, developer services enabled and unlocked

physical_correction.discriminator: Original sheet observer rejected a coordinator during a real began callback; the corrected physical fixture selects public navigation/presentation recognizers, binds the expected endpoints at readiness, and resolves once on the next main queue turn while still interactive.
physical_correction.cleanup: After any failed prompted cell, require a fresh request-bound operator release reply followed by a new native snapshot of zero touches, idle public pans and no transition coordinator. Otherwise defer teardown within the unchanged cleanup deadline.
physical_correction.transfer: At most one second read-only copy for the exact observed CoreDevice7000/POSIX60 failure, with matching command/device identity and the original deadline. Retain both actual responses and partial bytes; never reuse cached observations.
physical_correction.source_change: Physical fixture and capture only; both selected SDK revisions and original Duo observer/contract unchanged.

native_policy.successor: Only planned UIKit candidate after full native, backend, cleanup and visual qualification; no equivalent retry on mechanism failure.
native_policy.readiness: Fresh explicit operator availability and actual environment/access receipts before starting the separate pair clock.

physical_correction.release_guard: NATIVE_QUALIFIED_FOR_THIS_FAILED_CELL: actual reply, fresh same-owner zero-touch/no-coordinator snapshot, then task-only teardown.

event_capture_correction.objective: Repair shared human-session capture before another operator session; unchanged S2/S3 release criteria.
event_capture_correction.discriminator: The preserved physical sheet pan began at sequence95, but the single queued resolution rejected at96 before actual native disappearance98. A pan beginning is not proof that an interactive controller transition already exists. Resolve only on actual began/changed callbacks, retaining all candidate identities and states; never synthesize or retrospectively accept a boundary.
event_capture_correction.sdk_source: Both SDK revisions, the original frozen observer and old INVALID verdicts remain unchanged.
rules: Require original readiness, exact public endpoints/window/scene, live interactive coordinator and callback registration before interaction change.
No timer, queue-turn assumption, gesture delegate replacement, programmatic transition, source swizzle or new controller.
Retain each actual pre-binding pan callback and complete public coordinator inventory; reject foreign, ambiguous, ended, duplicate or late registration.
Preserve request-bound operator release plus fresh native idle before failed human teardown.
offline_controls: no coordinator at began then exact interactive coordinator at changed

qualification.scope: One baseline UIKit+SwiftUI stack qualification on an ordinary iPad simulator using supported UI input; success does not close physical or candidate release gates.
qualification.stop: Stop on first mechanism failure; no candidate or equivalent diagnostic series. Correct a further defect only from a newly captured discriminator.
qualification.additional_build_reason: Rebuild only the baseline after the consequential competing-pan review correction; original compiled product receives no native admission.

event_capture_correction.review_adjustment: Retain unrelated content-pan begin/probe/end observations without allowing them to satisfy a dismissal; reject unresolved or ambiguous chains.

display_schema_correction.discriminator: Actual ordinary iPad display inventory contains one lit primary integrated display and no active field. Existing Duo parser requires active=true. Failure preceded all input; no gesture/observer or SDK finding.
display_schema_correction.repair: Qualification-only ordinary-display parser and early actual-display preflight; original Duo active-display and fold checks remain unchanged. Reuse exact already-reviewed observer products.

native_policy.stop: Stop on first further mechanism failure; preserve actual responses and do not dispatch a successor.

display_schema_correction.missed_call: s2_webview_driver.display validates Duo active_display internally before returning bytes, so the scoped selector was not reached.

call_path_correction.repair: Scoped ordinary-display command reader used by both preinstall and each stack boundary; test the complete prompt path with real parser/publication and mock only external command and unrelated native snapshot. Original Duo command reader unchanged.

native_policy.stop: Stop on first further mechanism failure; preserve actual responses and do not dispatch a successor.

tool_contract_correction.discriminator: Workspace-free Xcode capture returns NotRun while its exact actual hierarchy names the already-launched task bundle and matching PID. No action was sent. The scalar tool state is not sufficient process-identity evidence.
tool_contract_correction.repair: Bind prompt bundle/PID and validate actual returned hierarchy before every action and after it, with native process/source/ownership checks unchanged. Preserve NotRun diagnostically rather than substituting state. Publish an explicit zero-action failure so the runner stops promptly and can prove input quiescence; uncertain action delivery still defers teardown.

native_policy.stop: Stop on first further mechanism failure; preserve actual responses and do not dispatch a successor.

boot_readiness_correction.discriminator: Xcode StartSession Booted precedes complete simulator readiness. Initial inventory retained a removed task registration pointing to nonexistent files; after simctl bootstatus -b completed, the registration was absent without another uninstall.
boot_readiness_correction.repair: Wait for actual bounded bootstatus completion before initial app inventory or installation; preserve raw command, stop before mutation on failure. No absent-directory shortcut or weakening of clean-install checks.

native_policy.stop: Stop on first further mechanism failure; preserve actual responses and do not dispatch a successor.

session_readiness_continuation.discriminator: StartSession returned a key but the first empty capture reported session not found. No gesture ran; zero-action failure publication and cleanup passed. Require an immediate successful empty capture of the fresh session before installing a task app.
session_readiness_continuation.scope: Existing unchanged reviewed baseline capture qualification only. No SDK, product, observer, oracle or helper changes.

session_probe.required: Actual successful complete hierarchy and screenshot response; preserve returned state and exact artifact bytes. No install if absent, failed or late.

native_policy.stop: Stop on first further mechanism failure; preserve actual responses and do not dispatch a successor.

session_readiness_continuation.review_reuse: Same frozen helper bytes and exact plan/controls/review bindings as the already scoped boot-readiness review. No new code changes.
session_readiness_continuation.stop: A second missing session is an environment blocker. No session restart or equivalent retry; preserve and restore original Shutdown.

session_handoff_correction.discriminator: Successful current Xcode capture was followed by two killed host launches and an expired handoff interval. Native execution must consume the ready receipt directly, without another model/tool round trip.
session_handoff_correction.repair: Start the bounded existing qualification runner before creating the session. Await and validate the exact current session-start and empty-capture receipts, retain actual artifacts, and dispatch the same existing cell immediately in that process. A failed, stale, foreign or missing receipt stops before installation.
order: SwiftUI only after full UIKit PASS
